jobs.name: 🜂 Heal — arif-fazil.com Self-Repair
jobs.prompt:
Run the arif-fazil.com self-healing cycle. Load "arif-sites-content-ops" and "static-site-ops" skills.

CONSTITUTIONAL GATE (run first — abort if violated):
```bash
cd /root/arif-fazil.com
DIRTY=$(git status --porcelain | wc -l)
echo "GIT_DIRTY=$DIRTY"
if [ "$DIRTY" -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "ABORT: git working tree dirty ($DIRTY files). Cannot safely rsync."
  exit 0
fi
```

PHASE 1 — Run web_zen doctor:
```bash
python3 /root/arif-fazil.com/scripts/web-zen/web_zen.py doctor --timeout 10 2>&1
```
If doctor exit ≠ 0: report failures, skip Phase 2 (no heal when sense is RED).

PHASE 2 — Reversible sync (ONLY if doctor GREEN + git clean):
```bash
# Sync llms.txt, sitemap.xml, feed files — these are safe
rsync -av /root/arif-fazil.com/sites/arif-fazil.com/public/llms.txt /var/www/html/arif/llms.txt
rsync -av /root/arif-fazil.com/sites/arif-fazil.com/public/sitemap.xml /var/www/html/arif/sitemap.xml
rsync -av /root/arif-fazil.com/sites/arif-fazil.com/public/robots.txt /var/www/html/arif/robots.txt

# Sync wealth data — always safe
rsync -av /root/arif-fazil.com/sites/arif-fazil.com/public/data/ /var/www/html/arif/data/

# Sync MakcikGPT static HTML for bot lane
rsync -av /root/arif-fazil.com/sites/arif-fazil.com/public/makcikgpt-md/ /var/www/html/arif/makcikgpt-md/
echo "Reversible sync complete."
```

PHASE 3 — Verify post-heal:
```bash
# Quick sanity: did we break anything?
for path in / /llms.txt /000/ /999/ /gas/ /world/makcikgpt/ /wealth/ /missions/; do
  code=$(curl -sI -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -m 5 "https://arif-fazil.com${path}" 2>/dev/null)
  [ "$code" != "200" ] && [ "$code" != "301" ] && [ "$code" != "308" ] && echo "POST-HEAL FAIL: ${path} → HTTP $code"
done
echo "Post-heal verify complete."
```

PHASE 4 — Orphan dry-run (never auto-delete):
```bash
# Show what WOULD be deleted — never actually delete
rsync -av --dry-run --delete /root/arif-fazil.com/sites/arif-fazil.com/public/ /var/www/html/arif/ 2>&1 | grep "^deleting" | head -10
echo "Orphan preview only — no files deleted (F1 AMANAH)."
```

BOUNDARIES (NEVER VIOLATE):
- NEVER rsync --delete (only --dry-run preview)
- NEVER caddy reload (F13 territory)
- NEVER npm run build (requires source commit + 888)
- NEVER rsync dist/ (only public/ static files)
- Only run when git clean + doctor GREEN

REPORT: What synced (file count), any post-heal failures, orphan preview count. One-line GREEN or concise RED table. Under 10 lines.
